text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock a 90m enablement workshop for Aurelia Health next week (they're ready to go live in 3 weeks). Goals: onboarding checklist, dedicated migration runbook, and handoff to SRE. Who can host? Prefer CET mornings.
Jordan Lee: I can host Tue/Wed morning CET. Prefer Tue 09:30-11:00 if that works.
Liam Chen: I can cover the runtime/infra demo and live Q&A. Tue is fine for me too, but I have a customer call at 10:15 — can join late if needed.
Priya Singh: I have the onboarding slide deck and pre-reads ready. I'll own pre-work distribution. Can do Wed morning as backup.
Maya Patel: Thanks — quick poll options:
• Tue 09:30-11:00 CET
• Tue 11:00-12:30 CET
• Wed 09:00-10:30 CET
Please react with :one:, :two:, or :three: (or type availability). We need a primary + fallback.
Liam Chen: :one: (prefer) — will move my internal call.
Jordan Lee: :one: works.
Priya Singh: :one: or :three:. I'll prepare the pre-read for both.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items:
1) Jordan to create calendar invite + Zoom and set 90m. Include recording + captions.
2) Priya to post pre-read and short checklist (5 min) 48h before.
3) Liam to prepare infra demo env and a short troubleshooting checklist.
4) I'll send the customer agenda and invite stakeholders.
Jordan Lee: Created invite: https://cal.example.com/event/abc123 — Added Aurelia stakeholders (product, infra, and ops). Recording enabled.
calendar-bot: Event created by Jordan Lee: Aurelia Health — Enablement Workshop — Tue 09:30-11:00 CET. Reminder set 24h and 1h before.
Priya Singh: Pre-read link (draft): https://drive.example.com/aurelia-prework — includes runbook outline, RBAC checklist, and quick start. Please review and comment.
Liam Chen: Quick infra checklist I'll demo:
```
1) Verify VPC peering & routing
2) Test model serving on staging (sample prompt + perf)
3) KV cache warmup script: ./scripts/warmup-kv.sh
4) Fallback policy validation
```
Maya Patel: Also flagging renewal contact — CC'd the renewals lead in the invite so we can capture any adoption signals. If anyone spots renewal risk items during workshop, add to the shared doc.
Jordan Lee: I'll include a 10-min slot for renewal signals and next steps at the end of the agenda.
Priya Singh: For feedback capture — I'll run a 3-question poll at the end (use case readiness, confidence in runbook, blockers).
Maya Patel: Perfect. If anything changes, ping here. Otherwise we proceed with Tue 09:30 CET as primary. Thanks team :thumbsup:
